title: Who Is a Political Prisoner?
note:
Two fixes to /publications/who-is-a-political-prisoner.

THE EMBEDDED PDF WAS NOT THERE. The body pointed an iframe at /storage/qt23p521p4_noSplash_b55493b510249c77305d1e9a270c4c04.pdf and that path returns 404 on the live site, so batch 153 unescaping the iframe would have produced an empty viewer rather than a document. The file is Ron Ridenour's pamphlet, held by eScholarship at the University of California. A copy is committed to database/data/files and installed into storage/app/public by this batch, so the embed does not depend on eScholarship serving the server — it refuses plain requests and only returns the file to a browser user-agent with a referer, which a cron or a deploy script would not survive.

The bare iframe is replaced with a figure that sizes itself to the viewport, carries a title for screen readers, links the PDF directly in case the inline viewer fails, and credits eScholarship as the source.

THE TITLE was stored in capitals — the h1 applies no text-transform, so the shouting was in the data. It becomes 'Who Is a Political Prisoner?'. The heading of the same words inside the article body is left in capitals, because that is the pamphlet's own typography rather than a display choice of this site.
